stages.label: Ic_Konstruksiyon_rev2
stages.provenance: DERIVED, not read from placements.json: robot 1's placement, reflected about the bus centre plane at cell Y = -137.2612 mm, composed with the inverse of the measured file-to-file transform (y2 = -y1 + -26.3411, x2 = x1 + -14121.0000, z2 = z1 + 3410.0000, read off the fixed stage). Robot2_EKSEN3's own matrix leaves X un-flipped, which turns the arm end-for-end instead of mirroring it and opens 126 mm at the column and 87 mm at the wrist.
